# Time integration {#sec-ch07}

This chapter advances the state in time. It takes as given the stage tendency of @sec-ch04 and the
sources of @sec-ch09 and describes what is done with them: the explicit strong-stability-preserving Runge-Kutta
stages, where the ghost exchange sits in a stage, the time-step bound, the acceptance or rejection of a step,
and the operator-split pieces at the end of a step; then the vertically implicit correction (VIC), which
replaces the explicit acoustic bound in $x_1$ by an implicit solve along each column.

Part 7A is the explicit machinery that every run uses. Part 7B is the VIC, which a run uses only with
`integration/implicit-scheme` set. The gravity terms inside the VIC operator belong to @sec-ch06 and are not
repeated here. The positivity limiters whose marks can reject a step are @sec-ch08; this chapter only reads
their marks.

| scheme | switch | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Explicit SSP Runge-Kutta stages (@sec-ch07-rk) | `integration/type` | `rk3` | 1, 2, 3, 3 | `test_forcing` |
| Ghost exchange in a stage (@sec-ch07-exchange) | driver API | MeshBlock: before | — | `test_mesh_multi_block` |
| Time-step bound (@sec-ch07-cfl) | `integration/cfl`, `implicit-advection-cfl`, `shear-cfl` | 0.9, 1, 0 | — | `test_implicit_advection_cfl_python` |
| Step acceptance and redo (@sec-ch07-redo) | `max_redo` | 5 | — | `test_check_redo_floor_python` |
| Operator split at the step boundary (@sec-ch07-split) | `thermo.reactions` | none | 1 (Lie) | `test_wall_saturation` |
| VIC options and activation (@sec-ch07-vic-options) | `integration/implicit-scheme` | 0 (off) | — | `test_implicit_options_type_python` |
| VIC block-tridiagonal assembly (@sec-ch07-vic-assembly) | as above | off | linearised | `test_backward_substitution` |
| Stage-weighted implicit step (@sec-ch07-vic-stage) | rk3 only | on with VIC | 1 | `test_forcing` |
| Block Thomas sweep and back substitution (@sec-ch07-vic-sweep) | as above | off | direct | `test_lu_failure` |
| LU pivot tolerance (@sec-ch07-vic-pivot) | none | $\epsilon_{\mathrm{piv}}=8N\epsilon_{\mathrm m}$ | — | `test_lu_failure` |
| VIC rejection and rollback (@sec-ch07-vic-reject) | none | on with VIC | — | `test_lu_failure` |
| VIC constituent redistribution (@sec-ch07-vic-redistribute) | none | on with VIC | conservative | `test_backward_substitution` |
| VIC column closure (@sec-ch07-vic-closure) | none | reflecting | — | none dedicated |
